name: mcp-argocd
description: Argo CD MCP server (MCP 2026-07-28): status, sync, rollback, drift, AppSets; writes or read-only

settings.name: ARGOCD_TOKEN
settings.description: Argo CD bearer token (also accepts ARGOCD_AUTH_TOKEN or ARGOCD_API_TOKEN)

settings.name: ARGOCD_URL
settings.description: Argo CD base URL including any path prefix (e.g. https://argocd.example.com)

settings.name: ARGOCD_READ_ONLY
settings.description: Alias for MCP_READ_ONLY. Any value other than false/0/no/off/empty locks the server read-only; --read-only can only raise the lock

settings.name: MCP_READ_ONLY
settings.description: Locks the server read-only: write tools and write-workflow prompts are not listed and nothing lifts the lock at runtime. Shared name across the mcp-* servers; set it in the deployer's env

settings.name: ARGOCD_HTTP_BEARER_TOKEN
settings.description: Bearer token (min 16 chars) required to bind an HTTP transport to a non-loopback host; clients send it as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'
